annotation.title_clean: Stakeholder Consultation on UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Held Today.
annotation.title_en: Stakeholder Consultation on UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Held Today.
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Ghana
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ghana's Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations reports on a March 2026 meeting where academics were consulted to validate Ghana's UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment (RAM). The draft findings say Ghana lacks binding AI-specific regulation and comprehensive data governance frameworks. The inputs will feed a national AI readiness report.
key_provisions_or_claims: The consultation validated Ghana's UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Methodology with input from academia.
The assessment examines policy frameworks, institutional capacity, digital infrastructure, data governance and ethical safeguards.
Ghana currently lacks binding AI-specific regulations and comprehensive data governance frameworks.
The findings will inform recommendations for strengthening Ghana's AI governance under the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI.
